meta.title: JobFit — does your CV fit the job?
meta.description: Paste a job, drop your CV, see your match score in seconds. Free and private: your CV is read in your browser.

check.title: Check your fit
check.intro: Paste a job, add your CV, and see which skills match. This part runs entirely in your browser.

job.label: Job description
job.placeholder: Paste the full job post here: title, requirements, nice-to-haves…

cv.label: Your CV
cv.drop: Drop your CV here, or click to choose
cv.hint: PDF, up to 5 MB · read on your device
cv.loaded: {words, number} words read · on your device

errors.empty: We couldn't read text from this PDF. It may be a scanned image. Paste your CV text instead.
errors.too-big: That file is over 5 MB. Try a smaller PDF, or paste the text.
errors.not-pdf: That doesn't look like a PDF. Upload a .pdf file, or paste the text.

check.needBoth: Add both a job description and your CV.
check.sampleBanner: You're looking at a sample with a fictional CV. Clear it to try your own.

result.label: Match score
result.summary: {have, number} of {total, number} skills from the job are in your CV.
result.noScore: Not enough skills found to score
result.noScoreHint: This job post doesn't list many specific skills. Paste the full post, including the requirements section.
result.tip: Only add skills you really have. Use the job's own words so screening tools find them.

footer.note: Free and open source. Your CV is read in your browser; we don't store it.

ai.title: Make it fit with AI
ai.intro: Rewrite your CV bullets, draft a cover letter, or prepare for the interview. Your name and contact details are hidden before anything is sent.
ai.sampleNote: This result was saved earlier, so the sample never calls the AI. Sign in to run it on your own CV.
ai.needInputs: Add a job description and your CV above first.
ai.runsLeft: {remaining, plural, =0 {No AI runs left today} one {# AI run left today} other {# AI runs left today}} · nothing saved
ai.runsPerDay: {limit, number} free AI runs a day · nothing saved

signIn.title: Sign in to use the AI
signIn.body: It's free: {limit, number} runs a day. Signing in only stops abuse of the free AI. We keep no CV, no results and no email address.
signIn.keep: Your job and CV stay in this tab while you sign in.

preview.title: What the AI will see
preview.intro: This is exactly what we send. Pink tags replace your personal details; they're swapped back on your screen only. Click any other word to hide it too.
preview.hiddenCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing hidden yet} one {# detail hidden} other {# details hidden}}

errors.unauthorized: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.limit: You've used today's free AI runs. They reset at {time}.
errors.provider: The AI is busy or out of free quota right now. This run wasn't counted. Try again in a minute.
errors.personal-data: We found contact details we couldn't hide. Hide them in the preview and try again.
errors.invalid: The job or CV is too long. Trim it and try again.
errors.network: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
